craft_notes: Sthāyin: utsāha at willed-measure — tenderness (vatsa) inside rigor. Vatsa vocative kept per UNC (child — tenderness address row 7); trifling-dismissal kept. Rejected: (a) dropping child → killed by UNC + row 7. (b) for→because → killed: L3 frozen hinge. Read aloud: CHILD, LOOK … FOR.

lines: Child, look — this as one — known of knowing, made of that, the world;
l4.sanskrit_cite: vatsa paśya tvam evaitat advayatvena saṃvidaḥ | viditaṃ tanmayaṃ viśvam anyat tuccham asad yataḥ

reads_against.argmap: Child, see what as nondual? → Behold nondual known world; other trivial unreal.
c1_essence: Behold one known made world; else trifling unreal.
